description: Request a screenshot of the current lot from the headless renderer. Requires roommate-or-mayor authority on the current lot. Returns path to the PNG file, image dimensions, and age of the cached frame. Rate limited: 1 per soul per 10 seconds, 10 per lot per minute.

args.name: level
args.description: Floor level to render (0-7). Default 1 (ground floor). Ignore if lot has fewer floors.

args.name: angle
args.description: Viewing angle: iso-ne (northeast isometric), iso-nw, iso-se, iso-sw. Default iso-ne.

args.name: zoom
args.description: Zoom level: small, medium, large. Affects pixel density of the output. Default medium.

args.name: roofless
args.description: If true, render without the roof so interior is visible. Default false.

call_signatures: cf $CF take-screenshot                                                                 # default: ground floor, NE isometric, medium zoom, roof on
cf $CF take-screenshot --level 1 --angle iso-ne --zoom medium --roofless false        # explicit defaults
cf $CF take-screenshot --level 0 --angle iso-sw --zoom large --roofless true          # bottom floor, SW angle, zoomed in, no roof
common_mistakes: Non-roommates (visitors) will receive category:not-permitted. Only roommates and the lot owner can take screenshots.
Rate limits are enforced: exceeding 1 per 10s per soul or 10 per minute per lot returns category:rate-limited.
The returned path is relative to /tmp/embody-$RUN/screenshots/ on the server; verify the file exists before transmission.
perception_hints: Use screenshots to debug spatial reasoning or validate placement. The renderer reflects the lot's authoritative state.
Rendering latency is typically 500ms-2s per frame depending on lot complexity and first-frame cache misses.
